name: weekend-folio
description: Save articles from any conversation and turn them into your own magazine: a PDF, a Kindle issue, or a printed copy by post.

interface.shortDescription: Your saved links as a magazine
interface.longDescription: Weekend Folio turns the articles you save into your own magazine. Give the assistant links to save, and ask what is on your reading list. Your next issue makes itself from the articles that wait. Get it as a PDF link, send it to your Kindle, or get a live quote for a printed copy that comes by post. A printed copy has no subscription: you pay for each one separately, at the printer's cost for printing, shipping and tax. The assistant can pay with your saved card only if you gave the connection that permission when you connected it, and only after you confirm one shipping option and its total. Without that permission, it sends you a link and you pay on the website. You need a Weekend Folio account. The plugin works only on the library of the reader who signed in.
capabilities: Send an issue as a PDF or to a Kindle
defaultPrompt: What is waiting on my Weekend Folio reading list?
Send me the PDF of my next Weekend Folio issue.
How much does it cost to print my latest issue?

positive.description: Save a link to the reading list
positive.prompt: Save https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paperback to my Weekend Folio.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the article. Gives its title and reading time, and the number of articles that wait for the next issue.

positive.prompt: What is waiting on my Weekend Folio reading list?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the articles that wait, with their titles and reading times.

positive.description: Get the PDF of the next issue
positive.prompt: Send me the PDF of my next Weekend Folio issue.
positive.expected_behavior: Gives a PDF link and the number of the issue. Says that the articles saved from now on go into the issue after it.

positive.description: Change the design of an issue
positive.prompt: Change my latest Weekend Folio issue to the Poster design.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the latest issue and says that it now has the Poster design.

positive.prompt: How much does it cost to print my latest Weekend Folio issue?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the page count, the destination, and each shipping option with its total. Charges nothing, and asks which option the reader wants.

negative.description: A shared link is not saved without a request
negative.prompt: Summarize this article for me: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paperback

negative.description: No access to the library of another reader
negative.prompt: Show me the Weekend Folio reading list of another reader.

review.commerce_description: Readers can order a printed copy of an issue of their own magazine. The price is the printer's quoted cost for printing, shipping and tax, with no markup. deliver_issue with "print" gets the quote and charges nothing. pay_for_print exists only when the reader ticked the print permission on the sign-in page, and that permission is off by default. It charges the reader's saved card through Stripe, only for a shipping option from the quote and only for its exact total. Without the permission, the reader pays on weekendfolio.com.

publication.release_notes: First release: save links, look after the reading list, make issues, and deliver them as a PDF, to a Kindle or in print.
